title: AI Auto Tilt: Central Beam and Zone Axis Detection, a Step Towards Autonomous Atomic Resolution STEM
content: Although transmission electron microscopes allow for atomic-scale imaging, they are challenging to operate and require a skilled operator to achieve atomic resolution, reducing the potential throughput. One of the most critical and time-consuming steps in the alignment procedure is tilting the crystal into a major zone axis relative to the electron beam. In recent years, a user-interactive approach has been introduced that requires input on both the central beam and zone axis to apply the proper tilt. This method significantly improves throughput but lacks the automation necessary for self-driving microscopes.
